info.name: Wish Marketplace V3 Brands Promotions Platform API

params.name: updated_at_min
params.description: Only return products that were updated since the given time. Currently only time with precision up to 'millisecond' will be accepted. Any time that is more precise than 'millisecond' level will be processed so that it only keeps its 'millisecond'.

params.name: updated_at_max
params.description: Only return products that were updated before the given time. Currently only time with precision up to 'millisecond' will be accepted. Any time that is more precise than 'millisecond' level will be processed so that it only keeps its 'millisecond'.

params.name: promotion_type
params.description: Promotion type for eligible products search. This field is required if there is no event ID specified.

params.name: product_ids
params.description: List of product IDs for eligible products search.

params.name: event_id
params.description: ID of the promotion event

params.name: limit
params.description: The limit on the number of products that will be returned.

params.name: sort_by
params.description: The attribute to sort products in the response. The most recently updated products will be returned first if `desc`.

params.name: id
params.description: ID of the campaign you want to Cancel

params.name: start_at_min
params.description: Only return campaigns that start at or after this time.

params.name: start_at_max
params.description: Only return campaigns that start at or before this time.

params.name: end_at_min
params.description: Only return campaigns that end on or after this time.

params.name: end_at_max
params.description: Only return campaigns that end on or before this time.

params.name: created_at_min
params.description: Specify the beginning of the time window to view desired campaigns when filtering by campaign creation time. Campaigns created before this time will not show.

params.name: created_at_max
params.description: Specify the end of the time window to view desired campaigns when filtering by campaign creation time. Campaigns created after this time will not show.

params.name: states
params.description: Restrict campaigns within provided states. Usually used with start_at_min/max and end_at_min/max filters.

params.name: promotion_types
params.description: Restrict campaigns within provided promotion types

params.name: product_id
params.description: ID of the product that result campaigns should include.

params.name: name
params.description: Name of the campaigns that result campaigns should include.

params.name: limit
params.description: A limit on the number of campaigns that will be returned.

params.name: sort_by
params.description: Only 3 fields are enabled for sorting:`start_at`, `end_at` or `created_at`. Default order is `desc`, use `asc` to sort in reverse.

params.name: id
params.description: ID of the campaign you want to query

items.docs: Get a single promotion campaign by its ID

params.name: id
params.description: ID of the campaign you want to update

params.name: ids
params.description: IDs of promotion events, if this field is non-empty, all other fields will be ignored.

params.name: promotion_types
params.description: Restrict promotion events within provided promotion types

params.name: submission_deadline_min
params.description: Only return promotion events with the submission deadline on or after this time. If the field is not specified, the current date-time will be used by default.

params.name: submission_deadline_max
params.description: Only return promotion events with the submission deadline on or before this time

params.name: limit
params.description: The limit on the number of promotion events that will be returned

params.name: sort_by
params.description: The attribute to sort promotion events in the response. Default order is descending (desc), use asc to sort in reverse.
